user.title: Live Track Commuter Rail
user.description: Where is the commuter railroad you want to watch? Only regions with at least one supported railroad are listed.

operator.title: Choose the railroad
operator.description: Each railroad is added on its own. Add another later to watch more than one.

credentials.title: {operator}: API key
credentials.description: {operator} asks each user for their own key. Request one at {key_url}. Its terms are at {terms_url}. The key is stored in Home Assistant with this integration and is never written to the log.

reauth_confirm.title: {operator}: new API key
reauth_confirm.description: {operator} refused the stored key. Enter a new one; keys are issued at {key_url}.

error.cannot_connect: The railroad's feed could not be reached or read. Try again in a minute.

abort.already_configured: This railroad is already set up.
abort.all_configured: Every supported railroad is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: The railroad's feed could not be reached or read. Try again in a minute.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the railroad's feed. Most feeds refresh about every 30 seconds.
data_description.show_parked_equipment: Off: equipment that is not in service appears only while it moves, and leaves the map after 10 minutes standing. On: every vehicle in the feed is shown, including parked consists.

map_card_yaml_resource.title: Add the Live Track map card to your resources

map_card_duplicate_resources.title: The Live Track map card is registered more than once
map_card_duplicate_resources.description: These dashboard resources also load the map card: {urls}. Only one is used and the others do nothing. Remove them in Settings > Dashboards > Resources.
